ui.settings.voice.label.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.voice.label.length: One line next to a switch; English is 13 characters.
ui.settings.voice.label.note: Master switch for session voice. Off by default.

ui.settings.voice.description.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings column; keep every fact.
ui.settings.voice.description.note: States that voice is off by default, that nothing runs while off, that on adds a composer button, and that off stops voice and frees the microphone at once.

ui.settings.voice.engine.label.role: Legend of a group of three radio options
ui.settings.voice.engine.label.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.voice.engine.label.length: One short line; English is 12 characters.
ui.settings.voice.engine.label.note: The choice of what hears and speaks for session voice.

ui.settings.voice.engine.description.role: Help line under the group legend
ui.settings.voice.engine.description.note: Says the choice is about where listening and speaking happen, and applies to session voice only.

ui.settings.voice.engine.local.label.note: Speech models running on this computer.

ui.settings.voice.engine.local.descripti.role: Help line under a radio option
ui.settings.voice.engine.local.descripti.note: States the speech models run on this computer and use about 5 GB of memory while voice is on. Keep the figure.

ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.label.tone: Short phrase, sentence case; ElevenLabs is a product name and stays as is.
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.label.note: The person brings their own ElevenLabs account and key.

ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.descriptio.role: Help line under a radio option
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.descriptio.note: States that the person's own ElevenLabs account is used, that nothing loads on this computer, and that ElevenLabs charges that account for the speech. Keep the cost fact.

ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.ready.role: Status line under the bring-your-own-key option
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.ready.note: Shown when an ElevenLabs key is stored and usable.

ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.missing.role: Status line under the bring-your-own-key option
ui.settings.voice.engine.byok.missing.note: Shown when no ElevenLabs key is stored. /login elevenlabs is a literal command the person types in Local Operator; do not translate or reword it.

ui.settings.voice.engine.radient.descrip.role: Help line under a radio option
ui.settings.voice.engine.radient.descrip.note: States that speech is billed with the person's Radient credit.

ui.settings.voice.engine.soon.role: Small badge beside a disabled option
ui.settings.voice.engine.soon.note: Marks an option that is shown but not available yet.

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.label.tone: Short noun phrase; ElevenLabs is a product name and stays as is.
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.label.note: The field where the person pastes their ElevenLabs API key.

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.save.role: Button label next to a password field

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.hint.role: Help line under the key field
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.hint.note: Says the key is kept in Local Operator's own credential store rather than in this app and is never shown again. Keep both facts.

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.saved_check.note: The key was saved and ElevenLabs accepted it.

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.saved_unver.note: The key was saved but ElevenLabs could not verify it. Keys limited to speech cannot read the route used for checking. Keep that it is unverified.

ui.settings.voice.engine.key.failed.role: Error line under the key field
ui.settings.voice.engine.key.failed.note: Fallback shown when saving fails and no reason is available.
